data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 82.5m (2016: GBP 81.9m) is a deterioration of GBP 4.2m (2016: deterioration of GBP 10.9m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to the unfavourable development of Property, Political Risks and European Creditor business.

prior_year_events.impact_description: adverse development on a legacy claim

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate recorded a net prior-year strengthening. Using the gross claims development table, older underwriting years (2011-2015) show a net adverse re-estimation of approximately GBP 6.8m (a 7.8% increase vs opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 87.3m). Management attributes the adverse movement principally to adverse development on the Property account (including Q3 catastrophe activity) and large/legacy liability claims, partially offset by favourable development in other areas. The report also records a net (after reinsurance) deterioration of GBP 4.2m in prior year reserves.
raw_causal_phrases: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 82.5m (2016: GBP 81.9m) is a deterioration of GBP 4.2m (2016: deterioration of GBP 10.9m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to the unfavourable development of Property, Political Risks and European Creditor business.

materially adverse performance on the Property account, following the Q3 catastrophes and development on a legacy claim, and the Non-Marine Liability account as a result of two large claims reported in the period.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (GBP 6.79m) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross basis) by comparing the latest ultimate for each underwriting year (<=2015) to the prior diagonal. The report also states a net prior-year deterioration of GBP 4.2m (net of reinsurance); the difference between the gross triangle result and the reported net movement reflects reinsurance recoveries and movements in reinsurers' share. Triangle contains footnoted cells (e.g. 65.61) and rounding; numbers presented are as printed. No explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision' line with a single gross figure was provided, so the triangle was used as the primary gross source.
